profile.summary: Senior Software and Database Engineer with significant experience in Java development as well as MongoDB, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.  Has actively participated in the full life cycle of several programs, from requirements analysis through development, system deployment, and sustainment.  Focuses on designing clean and scalable solutions and believes that good engineering practices are based on collaboration, open communication, and the willingness to learn.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Annapolis Junction, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer working on the LEGALEAGLE post-query review system for a U.S. Government customer. Supports many development and databases tasks on the program, including Java and ExtJS development for new functionality, troubleshooting issues that arise in the production system, upgrading the PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch databases, and creating SQL and PL/SQL scripts for purging and updating data.  Also assisting in the migration of the entire system from on-premises virtual machines to AWS.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.locationName: Annapolis Junction, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description: Senior software and database engineer assisting in reengineering a major information assurance and key management system for a U.S. Government customer into a modern framework.  Involved in the design, development, testing, integration, and deployment of the system. Software development was performed using Java 8 and the Spring Framework in a virtualized environment on a RedHat Linux platform utilizing the Scrum methodology. Also performed several significant database engineering tasks, including redesigning Oracle database schemas and developing scripts to migrate data between the discrete schemas, as well as leading the effort of deploying geographically redundant MongoDB replica sets to support failover across deployment sites.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer participating in the development and deployment of a Java Swing application on a Windows platform backed by an Oracle 10g, spatially-enabled database for a U.S. Government customer.  Performed both UI and backend development for this event-driven, multithreaded application and was also responsible for developing the majority of the JDBC code for performing calls against the database.  Also maintained, enhanced, and tuned the Oracle database and optimized complex queries.
positions.insights: Java Swing, Common Object Request Broker Architecture (CORBA) and +2 skills
